summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Deutsche Bank AG presenting its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains standard quarterly financial disclosures under IFRS, including income statement, balance sheet, and equity movement details. It does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or management change. The filing is a routine periodic report equivalent to a US quarterly report, with no event-driven corporate action warranting classification as a special situation.
